import re

# Test the regex approach for Galaxy Filter Tabular
# The regex must match the whole line (include_match) or find a pattern (include_find)
# We'll use include_find which just needs to find the pattern anywhere in the line

# Regex for > 90% methylation in the 8th CSV field
# Match field 8 (0-indexed: 7 commas before it) where value > 90
# Pattern: 7 comma-delimited fields before the methylation value
regex_gt90 = r'^(?:[^,]*,){7}(?:9[1-9]\.[0-9]+|[1-9][0-9]{2,}\.[0-9]+|90\.0*[1-9][0-9]*)'

# Regex for < 10% methylation  
regex_lt10 = r'^(?:[^,]*,){7}[0-9]\.[0-9]+'

# Combined regex
regex_combined = r'^(?:[^,]*,){7}(?:9[1-9]\.[0-9]+|[1-9][0-9]{2,}\.[0-9]+|90\.0*[1-9][0-9]*|[0-9]\.[0-9]+)'

with open('/workspace/ZF_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv') as f:
    header = f.readline()
    lines = f.readlines()

gt90_count = sum(1 for line in lines if re.search(regex_gt90, line.strip()))
lt10_count = sum(1 for line in lines if re.search(regex_lt10, line.strip()))
combined_count = sum(1 for line in lines if re.search(regex_combined, line.strip()))

print(f"Total data lines: {len(lines)}")
print(f"Matches >90%: {gt90_count}")
print(f"Matches <10%: {lt10_count}")
print(f"Combined (union): {combined_count}")
print(f"Expected: {268 + 271}")
print(f"Removed: {len(lines) - combined_count}")

# Check for any mismatch
import csv
with open('/workspace/ZF_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    expected_match = []
    for row in reader:
        v = float(row['MethylationPercentage'])
        expected_match.append(v > 90 or v < 10)

expected_count = sum(expected_match)
print(f"\nExpected from actual values: {expected_count}")
print(f"Regex combined count: {combined_count}")
print(f"Difference: {expected_count - combined_count}")

# Check false positives and false negatives
regex_matches = [bool(re.search(regex_combined, line.strip())) for line in lines]
fp = sum(1 for r, e in zip(regex_matches, expected_match) if r and not e)
fn = sum(1 for r, e in zip(regex_matches, expected_match) if not r and e)
print(f"False positives: {fp}")
print(f"False negatives: {fn}")

if fn > 0:
    for i, (r, e) in enumerate(zip(regex_matches, expected_match)):
        if not r and e:
            print(f"  FN: line {i+2}: {lines[i].strip()[:100]}")
            if i > 10:
                break

if fp > 0:
    for i, (r, e) in enumerate(zip(regex_matches, expected_match)):
        if r and not e:
            print(f"  FP: line {i+2}: {lines[i].strip()[:100]}")
            if i > 10:
                break
PYEOF

import bioblend.galaxy

API_KEY = "[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]"
URL = "https://usegalaxy.org"

gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url=URL, key=API_KEY)

# Download the actual filtered output
filtered_id = "f9cad7b01a472135878cb693134de857"
gi.datasets.download_dataset(filtered_id, file_path="/workspace/ZF_final_filtered.tabular", use_default_filename=False)

# Count lines
with open('/workspace/ZF_final_filtered.tabular') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

print(f"Filtered output total lines: {len(lines)}")

# Check header
if lines:
    first = lines[0].strip().split('\t')
    print(f"Header columns: {len(first)}")
    print(f"Header: {first[:3]}...")

# The original dataset has 19698 data rows + 1 header = 19699 total lines
# Filtered output: header + kept_data_rows
filtered_data_rows = len(lines) - 1  # minus header
total_data_rows = 19698
removed = total_data_rows - filtered_data_rows

print(f"\nOriginal data rows: {total_data_rows}")
print(f"Filtered data rows (kept): {filtered_data_rows}")
print(f"Rows REMOVED: {removed}")

# Quick validation - check a few methylation values
print("\nSample methylation values in filtered output:")
for i, line in enumerate(lines[1:6]):
    fields = line.strip().split('\t')
    if len(fields) >= 8:
        print(f"  Row {i+1}: Methylation = {fields[7]}")
